idea-plugin.name: VibeSSH
idea-plugin.description:
Build here, run it on your server.

Sends the artifact your build just produced to an application managed by VibeSSH and restarts it - without leaving the IDE. A Minecraft plugin lands in plugins/ and the server comes back with it loaded.

Talks to the VibeSSH desktop application over a loopback endpoint on your own computer. Nothing here reaches a network, and the token is kept in the IDE's credential store rather than in a file in your project.

Requires VibeSSH 0.1.0-beta.17 or newer, running, with Settings - Claude and other assistants switched on.

action.description: Send the built artifact to the configured VibeSSH application and restart it
